name: Two ponds
note: A second island for tests (?island=two-ponds), built by src/world/terrain/landform.js like the starter island; the fields are the same (see starter-island.json's note). It differs in shape: a low central rise, two smaller ponds on opposite sides each fed by its own spring, and three marshes: wide, shallow hollows with lumpy floors and no stream, which the rain keeps as standing water with tussocks showing (each must be at least 15 cm deep at its deepest and drain at least 120 m2 of ground, world/water.json summary). basins: ponds and marshes; a basin's floorScale gives it its own floor-noise frequency, and floorNoise large enough that tussocks break the water; soil sets how much of its floor is bare soil (a marsh is mostly grassy, drowned meadow under its water); starters gives it plants of its own on a new island (species id to count, on its suitable cells; src/world/growth/coarse.js), so every marsh starts with reeds and iris. springs: each with basin (the index it feeds) and fromBasinM toward the rise.

story.note: The island's own past under the ground (docs/future/13 10.7.7; src/world/dig/story.js): 0, 1 or 2 old hearths by these weights, within hearthFromCampM of the island's middle (it has no camp block), and the keeper's cache under a marked stone. letter: the cache's letter (recipes/world/keeper-cache.json).

stack.note: The light on the stack (docs/future/19; src/world/stack): a sea stack offshore, a fixed piece of every island. Read through stackLayout() in src/world/stack/layout.js. Placed on the side in sidesDeg (0 is +x, 90 is +z, turned up to jitterDeg by the seed) farthest round from the meadow islet's side, offshoreM out from the island's own shore on that line (further, up to maxOffshoreM, until its rock clears the open land the brushes reach), its skirt inside the world by edgeMarginM. noBuildM: the no-build ring round its middle (Matt, November 1, 2026: 20 to 30 m): shaping does nothing inside it, the tools show its edge as they show the camp pad's, and land raised inside it on an older island sinks back once. Its shape, in the Cliff tool's language (doc 08): a sheer core coreM across its middle (wobbled by coreWobbleM over `lobes` seeded lobes) standing heightM above the sea (the ground's ceiling is 12 m, so 11.5 m above the sea is about 14.5 m above the seabed); `ledges` level shelves stepping down one side, each about ledgeM wider (up to ledgeJitter of that more or less, seeded) and lifted up to ledgeLiftM off the even steps, each wobbling on its own; on the side ledgeTurnDeg round from the landward face, spreading ledgeSpreadDeg either way; faces soften over faceSoftM and are made craggy by cragM of noise at cragScale cycles a meter (never in front of the mouth); detailM bumps on its shelves; thrift: the share of thrift and campion (thin grass) on the ledges' tops. Round it a skirt of weed-hung rock at skirtTopM falling to the seabed over seaFallM. apron: a shelf at the foot of the landward face at heightM (above every tide), outM out from the face and halfWidthM either side, where the causeway lands; porch: where Matt's cave mouth stands (recipes/setpieces/stack.json mouthModel): its opening's foot outM out from the face (its back then sits in the face), its chamber's back chamberBackM out from it (the way in); the ground under its walls rises wallRaiseM, hidden inside the rock. The apron reaches outM beyond the mouth's front. soot: the band of old soot on the core's face from fromM to toM under its top, painted share of the dark earth layer. cameraMarginM: the view above may roam out over it this far past its rock.
